card.name: Linking words before 'the last dose'
card.fires_on: The word 'after' or 'following' right after a time span (e.g. '2 months') in contraception advice, just before 'the last dose'. Also a colon after 'once daily dosing' and 'the' in missed-dose advice before 'next dose'.

modes.label: Contraception after last dose
modes.description: 'after' or 'following' after a time span, leading into 'the last dose' in advice on contraception during and after treatment.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with VERZENIO and for 3 weeks<< after>> the last dose [see Use in Specific

modes.label: Missed dose wording
modes.description: A colon or 'the' in missed-dose instructions, leading into the next dose.
modes.example: unless it is less than 8 hours before<< the>> next dose, in which case, skip

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about doses, like 'daily', rather than words about starting or resetting.
card.plain: It marks the small word that comes just before 'the last dose' or 'the next dose' in dosing instructions.
